prompt.content: What Anglo-Saxon name was given to the place where the 4th-century pagan cult temple was excavated in 1928?

output:
The name given to the excavation site of the 4th-century pagan cult temple in 1928 is **"Bryn Celli Ddu"** (modern Welsh: **Bryn Celli Ddu**).

- **Bryn Celli Ddu** means "White Church of the Black (or Brown)
